one type of occupation. No two or more persons can be assigned same type of
occupation. Clerk is Chris's cousin. Hari lives next door to the plumber.

reach Hari's home. Identify each of the person's correct type of occupation, and
accordingly, which one of the following options is correct?

correct statement(s)?
options: There is no proof that India is affected by poor quality of water.
A few European countries are suffering due to occurrence of drought.
Lack of access to water can lead to social unrest.
Intense shortage of water is visible in some states of India.
